fields.summary: Autonomous plan run (no owner). The arbiter asked that the builder take the profile and allowed one profiled rhiza check now. That profile was taken on 2026-11-15 in the main checkout (24,560 entries, 127 MB). rhiza check took 13.8 s wall, with 18.5 s of CPU samples. model.WhatIf was 46% of the samples (check's in-flight problems pass 23%, its in-flight links pass 25%), model.asIs 26%, Model.clone in finishModel 14%. store.ReadLog was 7% (ReadEntries 6.4%, entry.Decode 4.3%), changeset.FoldLog 3%, textRefs 6%, the render comparison 2.4%. The repeated what-if builds are therefore the main cost, and the parallel decode can save about a second at most. No in-memory constructor of model.Seed exists today: only internal/index builds one, from its stored rows (loadSeed), so check needs a model function that builds the Seed from the change sets. Design choices were made by the planner and are recorded as assumed.
fields.title: Planning check without what-if rebuilds, autonomous, with a profile
